components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Theme-derived primary action with compact desktop spacing.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent-primary); color: var(--text-on-primary); padding: 8px 16px; font: inherit; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--interactive-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Vesta is a polished, approachable desktop workspace for configuring and launching a personal Minecraft setup. Its default liquid-glass expression is customizable and experimental rather than mandatory.
keyCharacteristics: Hierarchy relies on layered surfaces and selective elevation.
The default teal balances calm technical clarity, game energy, and customization.
Native desktop conditions and accessibility preferences override decoration.

rules.name: The Personal Palette Rule
rules.body: Derive new visual color from the active theme variables; never hard-code a competing product palette.

rules.name: The Depth-With-Purpose Rule
rules.body: Elevation signals hierarchy or interaction; it is not a substitute for structure.

dos: Do use semantic CSS variables so each interface remains coherent under every supported theme.
Do treat flat mode, light mode, reduced motion, and higher-contrast preferences as complete presentations.
Do keep desktop controls compact, legible, and recognizable before adding decoration.
donts: Don't hard-code decorative colors that bypass the theme engine.
Don't require grain, blur, or a particular window effect for hierarchy or readability.
Don't let personalization make text contrast, focus visibility, or semantic status ambiguous.
